name: Majitama!
source:
St. Agalias Academy.
A school that only those who excel in a single skill can attend.

Aiming to become a juggler, the protagonist enters this school that her father had also attended. Her father is also a juggler, and she admires him. However, the school can only be attended by those with "special" abilities!

As the protagonist deepens her friendship with the handsome but slightly foolish guys, she also has to hide the fact that she doesn't have a "special" ability...

Have you become bored with "ordinary" good-looking guys?!
Discover the new, "disappointing type" in this visual novel game!

[Translation of the DL Site [url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ126311.html]plot summary[/url].]
translation:
圣阿加利亚学院。
一所只有在某项技能上出类拔萃的人才能就读的学校。

主人公立志成为杂耍演员，进入了父亲也曾就读的这所学校。她的父亲同样是杂耍演员，她十分仰慕父亲。然而，这所学校只接收拥有“特殊”能力的人！

主人公与英俊却有些傻气的男生们逐渐加深友谊，同时还必须隐藏自己没有“特殊”能力的事实……

你是否已经厌倦了“普通”的帅哥？！
在这部视觉小说中，发现全新的“令人失望型”吧！
